title: Microsoft Copilot: delegated publishing of organisation prompts
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, current prompt-management roles and limits are supported, and searches confirmed the delegation documentation gaps. Minor corrections should distinguish planned delegation from current functionality, complete the management paths and acknowledge the published product-level licensing.

claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included and replace the notes with: 'Copilot Chat (Basic) is included with eligible Microsoft 365 licenses. Targeted licensing searches and the organizational-prompts prerequisites did not identify delegate-specific entitlement.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Prompts is the location for creating, editing, importing and pinning organization prompts.
claims.quote: Expand Copilot and select Prompts. ... Select Create prompt. ... select Edit. ... Select Import prompts ... Select Pin prompt from the more options menu (...).
claims.fix: The path correctly reaches the prompt list but stops before its actions. Keep 'Copilot > Prompts' and add to the row note: 'From the prompt list, select Create prompt or Import prompts; to edit, select a prompt > Edit; to pin, select a prompt > Pin prompt from the more options menu.' These are the routes at https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/organizational-prompts.
